title: Chemical peel
what: A solution with acids is put on your skin. It removes the top layer of cells, and the skin renews and becomes smoother.
why: For acne marks, dark spots, uneven skin tone, large pores, or fine wrinkles.
duration: the procedure usually takes 30 to 60 minutes; usually a course of several sessions is needed
tell_doctor: Cold sores on the lips, even if it was long ago
Medicines and skin creams you use
A tendency to scars or dark spots

prepare.title: Sun
prepare.text: For 1 to 2 weeks before the peel, avoid tanning and tanning beds.

prepare.title: Skin care
prepare.text: For a few days before, scrubs and strong products are usually stopped. Your specialist will say which.

prepare.title: Skin
prepare.text: On the day, come without makeup.

bring: A list of the products you use
steps: The skin is cleaned and degreased
The eyes and lips are protected
After a few minutes, it is washed off or neutralized
You are told how to care for your skin
feel: Burning and stinging during the procedure
Redness afterward, usually for a few hours or days
After a few days, the skin may peel
after: Do not pick at peeling skin
For a few days, avoid saunas, steam rooms, and pools
Use the gentle skin care your doctor suggested
red_flags: Severe pain, swelling, blisters, or crusts
Pimples with pus or a cold sore outbreak on the skin

faq.a: After a light peel, in 1 to 2 weeks. Usually a course of several sessions is needed.

faq.q: Can I have a peel in summer?
faq.a: Peels are usually done in autumn and winter. In summer, only gentle peels may be possible. Ask your specialist.

reminders.text: Chemical peel tomorrow. Come without makeup, avoid tanning, and do not use scrubs.
